propositions: GitHub re-evaluates job-level if conditions during workflow cancellation; jobs with always() predicates remain true and are not canceled, causing superseded matrix and reusable jobs to consume runner-seconds after replacement creation.

Commit 6f4123678c added leading always() predicates to seven full-route jobs, violating the same-change cancel-in-progress contract and delaying successor job admission by 1,510+ seconds in observed run pairs.
Full-route jobs must become ineligible when a workflow run is canceled while remaining eligible when the classifier fails without cancellation or when classification succeeds.

The fix replaces only the cancellation status portion of the seven full-route predicates with !cancelled() checks, preserving all other vote, ticket, classifier-result, and route conditions unchanged.

Workflow-contract regression tests confirm the fix is RED before the edit and GREEN after, with RED reversion when always() is seeded back, and live same-change replacement pairs demonstrate prompt stale-job cancellation without natural completion delay.
